turns.content: A keto acid gives a two-oxygen product with reagent X or its close analog. Use the functional-group change to identify the likely reagent family.
X contains a heavier isotope of one constituent element, and its unlabeled analog is a common organic reagent. Identify X and give its formula.
X reacts violently with liquid heavy water to release a gas whose molecule has equal numbers of protons and neutrons. Identify the gas and verify that count.
Identify the deuterated aluminium precipitate formed in this hydrolysis and the substance released when it is heated, using the latter's melting point near 277 K as a check.
For X, sum the nominal masses of all atoms of its lightest element and of its heaviest element, counting all four deuterium atoms.
Verify the isotope count, formula stoichiometry, and the two mass contributions independently.
Report X, the two contributions, and their sum.
